session.description: A clinic's calendar sync keeps failing.

documents.name: runbook.txt
documents.text:
Calendar sync runbook (invented).
E42: the sync token expired. Fix: open Settings > Calendars, choose Re-link, sign in again, then restart SyncAgent from the tray icon.
E17: the calendar was deleted on the server. Fix: pick another calendar in Settings > Calendars.
